### Batch Information
- **Batch Name/Code:** (e.g., CSE-A 3rd Year, ECE-B)
- **Academic Semester/Year:** (e.g., Autumn 2026, Semester V)

### Description of the Issue
Please describe what is currently incorrect in the schedule.
* **Day(s) of the Week:** (e.g., Monday, Wednesday)
* **Time Slot(s):** (e.g., 09:00 AM - 10:00 AM)
* **Current Incorrect Information:** (e.g., Subject: OS by Prof. X, Room 102)
* **Expected Correct Information:** (e.g., Subject: DBMS by Prof. Y, Room 204)

### Proof / Source of Truth
To ensure accuracy, please provide official source material verifying this change.
- [ ] Attached screenshot of the official PDF/Excel schedule
- [ ] Attached official notice link or photo of the notice board
- [ ] Verified with batch representative / advisor
